title: 鐵路號誌失效安全分析
summary: 本課聚焦號誌危害邏輯共同原因與證據鏈。從頂事件邏輯選擇建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把安全性質的狀態域與危害需求追溯連成可驗證的介面，最後以變更後證據重建整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies signalling hazard logic common causes and evidence chains. Start with selecting top-event logic to define physical or information boundaries, connect state domain of safety properties with tracing hazards to requirements as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through rebuilding evidence after change. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究頂事件邏輯選擇。原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。敏感度只改 p1=0.001 至 0.0011 1，輸出變為 0.0030978 1；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究共同原因殘餘風險：原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate selecting top-event logic. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. For sensitivity, change only p1=0.001 to 0.0011 1; the output becomes 0.0030978 1. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate residual common-cause risk: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇與共同原因殘餘風險
stages.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic & Residual common-cause risk
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂事件邏輯選擇」與「共同原因殘餘風險」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Selecting top-event logic" and "Residual common-cause risk": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂事件邏輯選擇」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Selecting top-event logic” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂事件邏輯選擇」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Selecting top-event logic” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂事件邏輯選擇」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Selecting top-event logic”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂事件邏輯選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Selecting top-event logic" is correct?
options: 任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘
本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。
裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障
optionsEn: If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.
Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
quiz.explanation: 本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂事件邏輯選擇」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Selecting top-event logic” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「頂事件邏輯選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Selecting top-event logic", which statement holds?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合

steps.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂事件邏輯選擇」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Selecting top-event logic” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。以「頂事件邏輯選擇」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. For selecting top-event logic, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把事件一機率 p1 從 0.001 改成 0.0011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.002998 變為 0.0030978 1。先說明「頂事件邏輯選擇」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only event one probability p1 from 0.001 to 0.0011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.002998 to 0.0030978 1. Explain the causal direction for selecting top-event logic, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂事件邏輯選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Selecting top-event logic"?
options: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂事件邏輯選擇」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Selecting top-event logic” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「頂事件邏輯選擇」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for selecting top-event logic. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。

stages.title: 安全性與可用度分離與安全性質的狀態域
stages.titleEn: Separating safety and availability & State domain of safety properties
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安全性與可用度分離」與「安全性質的狀態域」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Separating safety and availability" and "State domain of safety properties": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安全性與可用度分離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Separating safety and availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「安全性與可用度分離」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Separating safety and availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較安全停止與危險繼續輸出兩種後果，避免以服務持續時間推論危害發生機率。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安全性與可用度分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare safe withdrawal with hazardous continued output, avoiding inference of hazard probability from service uptime. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Separating safety and availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「安全性與可用度分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Separating safety and availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 安全性與可用度分離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Separating safety and availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安全性與可用度分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Separating safety and availability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 安全性與可用度分離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Separating safety and availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安全性與可用度分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Separating safety and availability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「安全性與可用度分離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For separating safety and availability, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「安全性與可用度分離」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for separating safety and availability, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 安全性與可用度分離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Separating safety and availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安全性與可用度分離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Separating safety and availability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「安全性與可用度分離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for separating safety and availability. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Consistent fault time windows” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元核對失效事件與任務期間的定義，避免把不同時間窗的紀錄直接放進同一風險模型。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「故障時間窗一致性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check definitions of failure events and mission duration, avoiding combination of records from different time windows in one risk model. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Consistent fault time windows” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
